title: The Cartographer's Vault: Final Treasure
description: With all three map fragments collected, the ancient treasure location is revealed. Fish at the pyramid on the Big Island during sunset hours (17:00-18:59) using your Ancient Magnet. You'll need a rod with at least 300lb capacity to retrieve the legendary vault containing the cartographer's ultimate treasure.
fishingTip: Fish at the pyramid on the Big Island during sunset (17:00-18:59). You need a rod with at least 300lb capacity and your Ancient Magnet to retrieve the vault!

rewards.description: The legendary vault contains treasures beyond imagination and completes your archaeological expedition.
